clusters.pick_reason: #2744 is preferred on two technical grounds: (1) its unconditional `str(uri)` conversion handles any URL subtype without requiring an explicit isinstance check against AnyUrl, making it more robust to future Pydantic URL type changes; (2) the validator is inserted after _empty_string_optional_url_to_none (line 85) rather than before it (line 67), which is the correct ordering — empty-string normalization should happen before URI coercion.
